assets.name: GrowthStats
assets.prompt: Generate ONE production pixel-art ICON ATLAS sprite sheet for a Korean fantasy incremental RPG. Exactly the specified uniform grid, edge-to-edge equal-sized cells, no outer atlas margin. Every cell has exactly one centered distinct icon and 15% transparent padding around its glyph. Entire background including gaps truly transparent. NO cell frames, NO tiles, NO panel background, NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO captions, NO dividers. Readable compact 24x24/32x32-era pixel symbols with chunky hand-placed square pixels and consistent scale, 5-8 colors per icon, dark plum outline and small ivory highlight. No realistic shading, no blur, no large glow or particle haze. Warm brass, muted green, violet and icy blue palette fits a dark plum UI and olive meadow game. Each icon must remain recognizable at 24 pixels. Follow row order exactly LEFT TO RIGHT, TOP TO BOTTOM.  EXACT GRID: 4 columns by 4 rows. ROW 1: (1) crossed short sword and small golden attack burst; (2) golden lightning bolt with two short speed marks for attack speed; (3) round blue mana potion; (4) blue mana droplet curving inward along a small silver arrow for mana absorption. ROW 2: (1) three stacked gold coins; (2) open violet experience spellbook with one tiny blue gem; (3) winged brown leather boot; (4) ivory target crosshair with one orange spark for critical chance. ROW 3: (1) cracked red-orange crystal exploding in three chunks for critical damage; (2) icy-blue shield with ivory star for brief invulnerability; (3) steel U magnet with red and blue tips; (4) emerald four-leaf clover for luck. ROW 4: (1) three small moss-green monster slime heads for monster population; (2) five small green monster heads enclosed by two gold corner brackets for population capacity; (3) three green monster heads beside one small upward gold arrow for simultaneous spawns; (4) olive hourglass surrounded by one circular gold arrow for respawn speed.
